mentions.description: A side-project journal app by hyraki, essentially a customizable version of Diarium that lets the author add any features missing from Diarium and Day One. It includes a distraction-free "writing" mode where everything disappears except the words, voice-to-text transcription that can be pasted into the entry body while keeping the recording, a better picture layout, and Apple Watch integration for speaking ideas directly into the watch. New feature ideas are easy to integrate.
mentions.problem: Existing journaling apps Diarium and Day One lack features the author wants: a distraction-free writing mode, better voice-to-text transcription with the recording preserved alongside pasted text, better picture layout, and Apple Watch integration.
mentions.audience: The builder's own journaling use; personal journalers who want a customizable alternative to Diarium and Day One
mentions.author: hyraki
